evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Here we introduce TSBench, a benchmark in which an LLM agent uses structure-editing tools to construct three-dimensional transition-state (TS) guesses verified by an automated quantum-chemical pipeline, yielding a physics-grounded pass/fail verdict.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: TSBench establishes a mechanism-level yardstick for LLM agents in mechanism-sensitive tasks such as synthesis planning and autonomous experimentation.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across 546 evaluations of seven frontier LLMs on 78 elementary reactions, the aggregate success rate rose from 50.4% to 66.8% under diagnosis-driven revision; the best models approached 90% on the simplest reactions, yet performance dropped sharply with mechanistic complexity.
